avis.texte: I wanted to love this product so bad. My usual anua serum was out of stock so I was recommended to use this one. Bad ideaaa! I rarely have a pimple a few times a year. This breakout im having is very unusual for me so I tracked it down to be this serum. It was the only new product ive added to my routine. I would not recommend this to anyone.

Im not one to write reviews, but reviews are always part of my research before buying a product. I bought this on sale and used it before reading the reviews. Im shocked by what people have written, there is no whit cast its not matte in anyway. It stings a little at first, like any active you aren't used to. I love this product, I'm 40 sensitive skin, some sun spots and rosacea. This has made a big difference i have the oridnary Azaelic acid & niacinamide which I was low and won't be repurchasing. This replaces both of those. It feels almost like a super thin oil. Not greasy but that very moisturized feeling after. I apply it after a toner, then essence, followed with moisturizer, the medicubes PDRN capsule (also amazing!) and wake up glowing and looking 5-10 years younger. But i really want to make clear, there ia no white cast….. i dont know what they bought or qhat they are reviewing but it iant thia product. Its not drying or matte. It did sting the first time, but never after and im really sensitive cant use any form or retinol or strong actives. This is a great product!

avis.titre: For the oily girlies with acne prone skin
avis.texte: I love this product's application and matte dry down feel. It keeps my skin calm, less oily, and controls breakouts like a champ. However, it did tingle a little with first several uses then it stopped. This will leave a "white cast residue" if you use too much or spot treat. I only use about 4 drops on my face and it does not do that. I always use this product with a hydrating essence/toner/serum before otherwise it can make your skin feel dry. I will keep repurchasing this serum as it is affordable and the most accessible 16% azelaic acid product out there!!

I love this product. It has helped tremendously with my rosacea/redness, for my husband as well. It does leave a bit of a white cast and can make your skin feel a little tight but we just apply skin care on top and both issues resolve!
I use this as my nighttime serum because it gets everywhere and leaves a noticeable white paper mache like cast. For me, it's super effective at resolving blemishes without inflaming my skin.

I have been using 10% azelic acid for over a year now to help with the redness of roscea. I thought i would try this to see if i got better results. This gave me a burning sensation and made my skin more red than it was when i started. It also left a white cast on my skin. I put a moisturizer over it after drying and it is now pilling. I never had this problem when i used the 10% azelic acid by Natrium. I would not recommend. I will go back to using Natrium.

You have to use a toner prior to using this or it will dry out your skin. Do not use this on a compromised barrier as well. It does work really well for my acne prone skin. It helps deflate ehatever acne that wants to pop up

After months of struggling with a weird acne breakout this has been the only thing that has calmed it. Its a bit harsh so definitely not for beginners as you MUST use this alongside some barrier repair products despite it being azelaic acid, but other than that, genuinely amazed that this product exists and is so effective!
Dries out skin and skin feels really tight- leaves a horrible white cast

I've heard great things aboht Medicube and Azaelic Acid. I have sensitive, dry skin and a damaged barrier. This is labeled as being soothing for sensitive skin, however it burned my face badly within seconds. My face is so red and hot now, even after washing with lots of cold water and applying moisturizer. If you try this, dont assume its gentle! Try a test patch first, as I should have.

avis.titre: WHITE CAST! Like really bad white cast
avis.texte: This product leaves a very bad white cast. It looks like I put white flour on my face. It also dries skin out and burns.

I started using this about a week and a half ago every night and using the moisturizer over it after it dried (1-2mins after application). It has taken my cystic and regular acne down so much. My face has been so bad and this is changing. I have tried microneedling, peels, everything! This is amazing!!!!

I started using the Ordinary cream version about a year ago and decided to try this. It was perfect! I do NOT recommend putting it anywhere you have sensitive skin. Works wonders on the rest of my skin. Drastically improved acne and marks.

I have VERY sensitive and acne prone skin. My skin barrier is in a good place right now, and I have had no issues with this stinging, burning, or worsening my redness. Admittedly, I was using a different azaelic acid for several months before this one. It seems to be doing well to keep my PIE under control, and I'm happy to see a higher concentration azaelic acid on the market. About half way through the bottle and will be repurchasing.
It burns after application & is pretty uncomfortable. Results so far hsvent been anything astronomical. I would've returened if Ulta hadnt refuced their return windkw so much

I typically use the anua azelic acid serum but I saw this and thought id try it, typically my skin really likes azelic acid serums and I have NEVER had this kind of reaction. after about 10 minutes everywhere I put the serum started burning and turning red and even after I washed it off my face and neck were itchy for the rest the of the day. my skin continued to be irritated and itchy for days after :/

I have issues with acne all my life and tried this for the first time and saw significant improvement within days. I use it as spot treatment on the acne and it disappears in about 2 days. I tried not to use too much as it leaves a white cast, but it could be easily fixed by layering with water-based serum on top. This product has the highest concentration of azelaic acid available in the market, it is worth every penny spent.

This product has a high percentage of azelaic acid in it for it to be a store bought product. With that being said, you must moisturize very well. Start off slowly and build up your tolerance. I got too excited using this product at first and tried to used it daily and it dried my forehead out. I corrected it by using oils and taking a break from this product and other actives on my forehead only as the rest of my face was fine. Put on a hydrating essence before using this and make sure you moisturize well after using it. Also pat it in the skin, because when I was rubbing it on my face it left white residue on me. I have been using it for a few short weeks and I am seeing some improvements! I'm definitely going to continue to use it to see how it continues to improve my skin.
This gave me the worst reaction :( I dont have sensitive skin & I use actives all of the time but this made my skin burn and flush so badly. Almost felt like an allergic reaction. I would stay away!!

avis.titre: The best Azelaic acid I've ever tried!
avis.texte: The best azelaic acid I've ever tried! And I've tried them all! This one is much better than ANUA. It doesn't irritate my skin, and I noticed a difference after the first use.

avis.titre: super soothing on red, acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I've only been using it a week and a half, but so far it's my new favorite azelaic acid serum! this formula is super calming and I love how it sinks into my skin. my acne has calmed a ton just in one week. looking forward to how much more my redness responds to this! also the highest percentage one i've found without a prescription, please never get rid of this one!

Been loving this so far! Im a week into trying this product and I am really impressed how it absorbs into my skin and actually feels like its working. Im a natural red head so im usually really sensitive.
I dont have sensitive skin, but this burned really bad and left my face red. So if you have sensitive skin, I really don't recommend this.
I was so excited to try this serum;however, there is a layer of white residue left on my face. I'm not a fan and will try another brand
Don't recommend for sensitive skin. I was excited to try this serum as my skin usually reacts well to Azelaic acid but this burned my skin i had to wash it off immediately
